scenes.caption: Back at Lakeside Golf Collective, Riley opens the Summer 2026 season roster. The Blue Heron Flyers carry their regular athletes, Ava Stone and Sam Finch — assigned to this season, so participation always stays with the season.
scenes.tts: Back at Lakeside Golf Collective, Riley opens the Summer twenty twenty-six season roster. The Blue Heron Flyers carry their regular athletes, Ava Stone and Sam Finch — assigned to this season, so participation always stays with the season.

scenes.caption: Reserves live outside the teams. The season's own men's reserve pool holds Ben Reed — ready to fill in, but excluded from ordinary scheduling until he is officially called on.
scenes.tts: Reserves live outside the teams. The season's own men's reserve pool holds Ben Reed — ready to fill in, but excluded from ordinary scheduling until he is officially called on.

scenes.caption: For the Week 3 event, Ava can't play. Riley records a substitution: the event, Ava out, Ben in, plus the reason — one append-only record that names exactly who replaced whom.
scenes.tts: For the Week Three event, Ava can't play. Riley records a substitution: the event, Ava out, Ben in, plus the reason — one append-only record that names exactly who replaced whom.

scenes.caption: And nothing else moved. Ava is still on the season roster, and Ben is still in the reserve pool — the substitution applies to that one event only, so the season's participation history stays intact.
